correctness.rationale: Independent code scanned all 8! even-to-odd bijections and retained exactly the cube-edge matchings. It formed adjacency by swapping two odd partners precisely when both crossed edges exist for the two even vertices opposite on a square. This gives exactly the legal move, with no hexagon moves or quotient by symmetry. Complete component traversal gave 272 states, 768 edges and one 264-state component plus eight singletons. All-source BFS in the mobile component reproduced the eight distance bins (768,2640,6032,9360,9504,5296,1104,12), totaling 34,716, and eccentricities 7 on 252 states and 8 on 12 states. It checked the supplied witness at distance 8, equality of the degree-four and peripheral sets, and a two-regular farthest-pair graph on three connected four-vertex sets. Applying all 384 translations composed with coordinate permutations verified both the peripheral matching orbit and the unordered diametral pair orbit. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/e5186c03-e039-4713-b9ae-b355aac582e1/independent_q4_audit.py.
